digest.component_or_area: backend-neutrality test gate and adapter architecture
propositions: inbound_fields.py must remain at rebar_reconciler package root to allow Data Center and Cloud adapters to share it while maintaining the J7 sibling-adapter seal forbidding adapters/jira/ and adapters/jira_datacenter/ from importing each other
moving inbound_fields.py to adapters/jira/ would violate the J7 seal by allowing jira_datacenter to import from jira
moving inbound_fields.py to adapters/jira_family/ would violate the mirror-image rule because root-core importers (inbound_differ.py and peer_state.py) cannot consume the jira_family layer
the backend-neutrality sweep exemption comment must be rewritten to explain the permanent architectural reason for the exemption rather than treating it as temporary relocation debt
